description: This file implements functions related to managing settings within a WebSockets library, including initialization, deinitialization, and formatted printing of settings values. It defines functions for setting up and tearing down a settings instance and for formatting and sending setting values via provided function pointers.

methods.name: lws_settings_instance_t * lws_settings_init(const lws_settings_ops_t * so,void * opaque_plat)
methods.description: Initializes a settings instance with provided operations and platform-specific data.

methods.name: void lws_settings_deinit(lws_settings_instance_t ** si)
methods.description: Destroys a settings instance, freeing associated resources.

methods.name: int lws_settings_plat_printf(lws_settings_instance_t * si,const char * name,const char * format,...)
methods.description: Formats and sets a setting value, passing it to the provided callback in the settings operations.
